tip: Peel garlic effortlessly by smashing the cloves with the flat side of a knife. The skin slips right off!

Install a pull-down kitchen faucet for better flexibility and reach when filling large pots or washing dishes.

Place a baking sheet under pies or casseroles to catch drips and make oven cleaning easier.
Use drawer liners to keep utensils and tools from sliding around and to protect drawer surfaces.
